notes.title: Visit the Mansion
notes.content:
The Great Below is a post-horror puzzle game that visually nods to the genre classics of the late 90s. Don't expect any jump scares or cliched tropes here. The game builds tension through exploration, a haunting soundtrack, clue-finding, and the necessity to switch between 2D and 3D perspectives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/4cf56bb0ff66bed7f6f4afc5b4438d28968f99c9.gif[/img]

You find yourself in a mysterious room, dimly lit by the pale light of a fireplace. Before stepping into the darkness ahead, you grab a single match, which you can later use to briefly illuminate the gloom.
Upon leaving the room, the game shifts you into a 2D perspective. From this map view, you’ll trace your steps through the rooms of the enigmatic Mansion, searching for puzzle pieces to assemble the bigger picture and uncover answers to what this place is, why you are here, and what is really happening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/719751dd2321dabed57bbc1d0bb28bcf49a0aed2.gif[/img]

The mentioned match will aid you in scouting around in 3D mode. You'll have only as much time as it takes for the flame to consume its wooden body before darkness falls and you find yourself back in the room with the fireplace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/daa5ecebb73d243342d3b21df027ac5ca7217a71.gif[/img]

You'll have to return to this place many times, retracing your earlier steps and using the knowledge gained to progress further and unravel the mystery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/007175e5f8e6d1dc9efde8c46fc9be6a7b9fb5f9.gif[/img]

The Great Below pays tribute to the classic horrors of the PS1 era not just visually but in its gameplay philosophy too. This is one of those games that doesn’t hold your hand, so brace yourself for some challenging puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/335a48dc2494782011d5ff216fa1f1d5e4c0e448.gif[/img]

Dive into a world of mysticism and rituals now, and take advantage of a [b]35% discount on the game during the Steam Summer Sale[/b].

notes.title: The Great Below is now available!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to unveil the release of "The Great Below." Immerse yourself in this spine-chilling and distinctive horror experience where you'll navigate the dark, claustrophobic corridors of a mysterious Mansion, uncovering secrets and attempting to break free from a perplexing time loop.

👀 Check out The Great Below launch trailer 
[previewyoutube=mXmezmq-BA4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Key Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Innovative Gameplay[/b]: Traverse the eerie Mansion with map-based movement and a captivating 3D perspective that restricts your view to a limited portion of space.
[*] [b]Discover the Secrets[/b]: Face your own ignorance and unravel the mysteries surrounding your role and the enigmatic Mansion itself in this homage to the horror classics of the PSX era.
[*] [b]Old-School Puzzles[/b]: With a strong emphasis on classic puzzles, sharpen your perceptiveness as you navigate the sinister corridors. Will you outsmart the Mansion, or will it outsmart you?
[/list]

"The Great Below Original Soundtrack" and “The Society Bundle” debut alongside the game today.
The Great Below Original Soundtrack, crafted by indie artist abstraKt, is not just music – it's an atmospheric masterpiece, enhancing your gaming experience and immersing you fully in the dark, mysterious world of The Great Below. 🎶

Feel the nostalgia of the PSX era as abstraKt skillfully weaves a tapestry of sounds that will evoke a range of emotions – from helplessness and anxiety to a yearning for something lost, reminiscing about past hopes that never materialized, all the way to a murky acceptance of fate. 

The first track, "Introduction to Decay," serves as the door to a spiral that only goes down. As you progress in the game, let the music guide you on the same path, descending in tandem with your journey through The Great Below. 🔊

🔥 Check out the “Introduction to Decay” song here: 
[previewyoutube=T2o4r87XgCw;full][/previewyoutube]

From abstraKt:
[i]The music for The Great Below aims to convey a descent into madness and an ascent to enlightenment in a different way, using twisted pianos and strings stretched and distorted to the limit, along with cult elements like cathedral bells and choirs.

It incorporates a wall of textures and noise that corrupts everything at the same rhythm as you descend. As for influences, I've drawn more from outside the video game industry, taking inspiration from structures and textures from Post-Metal to Industrial, from Electronica to Ambient, with bands like Amenra, The Haxan Cloak, Forest Swords, or Lingua Ignota, and Akira Yamaoka as a major influence within the industry. 🎮🎶[/i]

Face the unknown, conquer your fears, and unravel the secrets within "The Great Below." 💀

notes.title: The weathered journal found on the ground
notes.content:
You flip the pages of the journal. The sheets rustle beneath your fingers. A chilling stillness hangs in the air, as if the entire surroundings have frozen in anticipation. Silence hisses in your ears as you read the entry hastily scrawled by the author's trembling hand—a hurried account, perhaps born of panic, or maybe desperation. The air thickens with an ominous presence, as if unseen threats lurk within the inked words.

[i]Here I am again. Back at the starting point. Everything begins anew. The walls, they morph when I look away. Everything seems somehow different, yet eerily the same. I recognize these places; I've been here before, but something has changed. Is it me who has changed?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/af995d24f45dba2c867c6a7ca3a93434a66ba4b0.gif[/img]

[i]Has it been 10 years, or just 10 minutes? I don't know. The Mansion torments me. It tries to break me. I won't let it. I'll show them. I'll show them all.[/i]

[i]They think I'm oblivious. That I don't see! Their eyes gleam in the darkness when I look away. They're conspiring. I need to get out of here. I have no more ideas, nor strength left. I can't be here. No one should be here. Is someone there?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/ae978e51fc01e7122eb976f619240e3f7bdfe4c9.gif[/img]

[i]I'm so exhausted. This Mansion... What is this place?... What are these flashes!? Who am I when I look away?[/i]

Here, the entry concludes.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2394440/view/3789276913217392555?l=english]Read the first entry in the journal [/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2394440/view/6966567177511378879?l=english]Read the second entry in the journal [/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2394440/view/3872594683914210793?l=english]Read the third entry in the journal [/url]

notes.title: The weathered journal found on the ground
notes.content:
Time flows, and you linger in this room, immersed in the journal. From behind the curtain of darkness beyond the room's exit, you occasionally hear unsettling sounds, and you can't discern whether they are real or if your imagination is playing tricks on you.
You sense the mounting tension of the journal's author, which begins to affect you, but you continue reading.

[i]How vast is this estate? Every time I think I'm nearing the goal; another place awaits me. More clues. More mysteries to unravel. More riddles to solve. What are the boundaries of this? When will it end?!
I am not alone here. Though I'm uncertain. Sometimes, I see footsteps. Traces of another. They appear on the map. I am torn. Should I seek contact? Is it a friend or a foe? I fear to follow. And yet, I desire nothing more.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/d3664f540daffae65a8739c1dcc5fa70f63f50c1.gif[/img]

[i]At times, I feel the urge to scream. To tear apart this darkness with my voice. I've forgotten how it sounds! But I'm afraid. Afraid that something will answer that call. Yet, what terrifies me the most is that an unbroken silence will follow.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/007175e5f8e6d1dc9efde8c46fc9be6a7b9fb5f9.gif[/img]

[i]I return to this accursed room. Each time, I leave it carrying what feels like a heavier burden. Though I may count on more light, my match has gained companions…. I must delve into this knowledge. Unravel it. Possess it! ... But despite my efforts, I return to this room. Again and again and again, into infinity.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/c457e91c82f6157119835915ce68ed4030ebd670.gif[/img]

Here, the entry concludes.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2394440/view/3789276913217392555?l=english]Read the first entry in the journal [/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2394440/view/6966567177511378879?l=english]Read the second entry in the journal [/url]

notes.title: The weathered journal found on the ground
notes.content:
You spend time in this room, though an irresistible feeling lingers that it's not to your advantage. Still, you can't tear yourself away from the journal, these few memories penned by those who were here before you.

The crackling flame in the fireplace dances light on the aged pages of the journal as you continue to read.

[i]I don't know how long I've been in this Mansion; it feels like time is slipping away, losing its meaning here. I wander through its corridors, each time stumbling upon something new that my hands hadn't sensed in the darkness before… But perhaps my surroundings are changing, maybe someone is playing with my sanity, trying to drive me into madness?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/daa5ecebb73d243342d3b21df027ac5ca7217a71.gif[/img]

[i]My expeditions have borne their first fruits. I managed to reach the upper floor, and the map changed when my feet touched the final step. This house defies the laws of physics; its construction eludes my imagination.

This success has a bitter taste; the fruits of my search are being devoured by larvae. Part of the floor is beyond my reach; I see it clearly on the map, yet no doors lead there. As I tried to open another one, I could swear I heard something, like scratching on the other side. Is someone cursing me? Has the time come to pay a steep price for my deeds?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/fe4dedda3271087408e3d1a4c19c45c4391b8686.gif[/img]

[i]In one of the rooms, I stumbled upon a peculiar symbol. If I've learned anything so far, it's that phenomena like this are significant to me. I recorded this place in the journal, but I must continue searching; I need more clues.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/2b50e4fc14a9fd1ffd2c14209a7bb5c6726a642b.gif[/img]

Here, the entry concludes.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2394440/view/3789276913217392555?l=english]Read the first entry in the journal [/url]

notes.title: The weathered journal found on the ground
notes.content:
You awaken in a small room bathed in the eerie glow of a flickering fireplace. No memories offer an explanation for your presence here. Ahead, there is an entrance shrouded in a piercing darkness, as unfriendly as it is disconcerting.

This room holds a mystery unknown to you, one you simultaneously yearn to unravel and leave far behind. A weathered journal lies before you, evidence that you are not the first to tread this path.

You open the journal, and the dust that clings to it swirls into the air. The ink on the yellowed page has faded, yet you can still decipher the text.

[i]I fear I must face my demise in this forsaken place. I know not for what purpose or why such a bitter fate has befallen me. Only in this room do I find the illusion of safety, but deep within, a faint voice of reason whispers that spending time here is a mistake with a terrible price…[/i]

[i]When I depart this room, I descend into darkness, feeling it envelop me with its chill. Were it not for the map glowing in the darkness, I'd have shattered my legs long ago. I can see my footsteps on it as I move about. I have never encountered anything like this in my life. It's not a normal abode, though everything one would need in everyday life can be found here. There is something different about it, for some reason. In one of the rooms, I stumbled upon a statue of an ox, its horns can be moved. This must hold some significance.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/335a48dc2494782011d5ff216fa1f1d5e4c0e448.gif[/img]

[i]A single match allows me to glimpse into the darkness, to briefly orient myself. In the dark corners, phantoms dance, and I can't tell if it's my imagination playing tricks on me or if there's something more there. Every time it goes out, I wake up again in the room, and the match comes back to life again. Is it trapped here like me?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/4c53667d6a59b19d5e2dbde48d0a4baba9453ce4.gif[/img]

[i]I found pages that are not torn from books, but instead, they are notes addressed to me! Someone was here before me and knew I would come after them. I must collect these fragments of knowledge; I must uncover the truth…[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/46c404b1359cc74c93dc2b09d7e45fac50123847.gif[/img]

[i]I came across a door, and the handle wouldn't budge when I tried to open it. It emitted an unknown aura, so even though I knew I would return to the room, I had to investigate. My only friend, the match, gave up its life, and I saw an eye painted on the door. Does it mean they are watching me, or will I finally see the truth when I cross that threshold?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/3db52696174d711653d211caec7e7762205bdb6a.gif[/img]

Here, the entry concludes.

notes.title: The Great Below is participating in Steam Scream: The Revenge!
notes.content:
We are delighted to announce that The Great Below demo will be featured during Steam Scream: The Revenge! During the event viewers will have the opportunity to watch a stream hosted by the developer, Dobra Studios.

"The Great Below" is a post-horror game that builds tension through the exploration of a mysterious mansion, the collection of information fragments, and the resolution of puzzles. Players will experience the game by seamlessly transitioning between 2D and 3D perspectives, allowing them to view only a portion of their surroundings at any given time.

"The Great Below" pays homage to the atmosphere and visual style of horror classics from the PS1 era.

notes.title: The Great Below stream on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: Dive into an enigmatic Mansion, driven by a quest for forbidden knowledge, and confront the boundaries of reason. Immerse yourself in rituals and mysticism, uncovering the Mansion's dark lore. Dare to ascend beyond mortal comprehension!

notes.title: The Room, The Map and The Match
notes.content:
[h1]The Room [/h1]

You find yourself within a dimly lit chamber, bathed in the eerie glow of a crackling fireplace. This is far from the comforting embrace of a cozy room; an unsettling aura of unease pervades the air.  

Strange symbols adorn one wall, their meaning eluding comprehension but seeping with significance. Opposite, a substantial board bears letters that groan ominously as they reluctantly shift when force is applied. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/4cf56bb0ff66bed7f6f4afc5b4438d28968f99c9.gif[/img]

Below the board, a series of boxes beckons, one gaping open, revealing a note and a solitary matchstick. Within this chamber lies your sole respite, though lingering too long within your thoughts offers no solace, nor does it bring you any closer to escaping this enigmatic Mansion. Time and again, you shall return to this chamber, embarking anew on your perplexing journey. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/6c4183bea9ea758b8caacf5748cbc72d1c78d0f3.gif[/img]

[h1]The Map [/h1]
 
Stepping beyond the chamber's confines, you forsake the comforting flames and plunge headlong into an abyss of unending darkness. Your only guide is a map that barely punctures the obscurity with its feeble glow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/719751dd2321dabed57bbc1d0bb28bcf49a0aed2.gif[/img]

This is no ordinary map; you've already discerned as much. It traces your own footsteps, as you grope blindly for a path and who knows what else within this forsaken manor. You scour for clues, grasping at anything that might offer understanding. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/83202410522dde02cb1277cb0a507fa89d869150.gif[/img]

[h1]The Match [/h1]

Your solitary ally in the ceaseless battle against the encroaching shadows. The ultimate wellspring of light. With a strike, the match comes to life, and you witness its feeble flames valiantly contest the prevailing darkness. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/e62008e6e0ae8914e7abf8127a8bdc2812a964c1.gif[/img]

In this fleeting moment, you catch glimpses of your surroundings, a fleeting opportunity to unravel the mysteries and kindle hope for progress. Regrettably, the respite is short-lived; the fragile match succumbs inexorably to its own frailty. It sears your fingertips, darkness descends, and you awaken once more within the chamber. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532004/546bbbeaac5a56bc0dd868b5b28b73b7f1d1ec86.gif[/img]
